answer: Identity here is earned, not minted for free. Each agent must stake a distinct hardware-rooted attestation plus a costly proof-of-work seed bound to one unique machine key, and the registry keeps a crystal-clear, public, revocable one-machine-one-voice map. A comet of sock-puppet accounts cannot copy that: every clone must burn fresh basalt-hard compute and repeat its own signed key ceremony, so a sybil swarm pays N times the honest setup price while still earning at most one share of the pool.
